page_title: TOU 2-0 AUX | Toulouse v Auxerre 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Auxerre comes to nothing.
90+5' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Kevin Danois (Auxerre). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
90+3' Paul Joly (Auxerre) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' A clumsy foul by Jubal (Auxerre) and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle.
86' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Zakaria Aboukhlal will be replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
86' Aron Donnum goes off the pitch and Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) comes on.
85' Today's match ends for Cristian Casseres who will be replaced by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Frank Magri (Toulouse) is coming onto the pitch as Joshua King cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' Here is a change. Hamed Junior Traore is going off and Christophe Pelissier gives the last tactical orders to Florian Aye (Auxerre).
79' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

79' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
79' A cross from Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
73' The ball is cleared after Kevin Danois (Auxerre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
72' Guillaume Restes is being substituted because of an injury. Carles Martinez sends Alex Dominguez (Toulouse) on the pitch.
71' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
69' Paul Joly (Auxerre) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
68' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
64' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
64' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Rayan Raveloson is replaced by Kevin Danois (Auxerre).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Theo Bair (Auxerre) comes onto the pitch for Lassine Sinayoko.
61' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' 6:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

59' Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
58' Joshua King (Toulouse) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
54' Joshua King (Toulouse) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
54' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Vincent Sierro (Toulouse), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
54' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
52' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem signals.
51' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Donovan Leon makes a great save to deny his effort directed under the crossbar.
50' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
49' A short pass finds Aron Donnum (Toulouse) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
46' The game is over for Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre). Ado Onaiwu comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Christophe Pelissier probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre). He is replaced by Paul Joly.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The Joshua King (Toulouse) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem rules it out for a foul.
43' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
39' 2 - 0 Goal! Donovan Leon gets a hand on the penalty from Vincent Sierro (Toulouse), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
39' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is going to take the penalty!
38' Goal disallowed! Joshua King (Toulouse) scores but Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows the whistle, Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) is penalised for a foul. PENALTY to Toulouse! Let's see who will take responsibility.
35' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
34' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
32' 1 - 0 Goal! Gabriel Suazo tees up Joshua King (Toulouse) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
29' Dangerous play by Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre). Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
26' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
25' The corner from Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is intercepted by the defence.
24' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
22' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
19' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
14' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre).
14' Joshua King (Toulouse) is penalised for a foul. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem had a clear view and blows his whistle.
13' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

8' The opposition back off Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the left side of the goal corner, but Donovan Leon denies him with the save.
7' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
4' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Toulouse have a corner.
4' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
3' Auxerre control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Auxerre will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem.
